_comment: Recorded behaviour of each grader against real responses from both versions. A discriminator must fail on 4.3.0 and pass on 4.5.0; a floor must pass on both. Replaying these in CI proves the graders still mean what they meant when they were tuned. It does NOT exercise a new skill version - only a live run does that.

five-fields.note: 2 of 3 recorded 4.3.0 runs used the five fields; this fixture is one that did not.
